## Context / Problem
The infra/terraform cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `infra/terraform/acm.tf:1-7,40-44` — Preserve adopted wildcard cert, DNS validation records drive renewal, `prevent_destroy`, direct ARN consumers. Consumer: Terraform operators.
- `infra/terraform/iam_bridge_metrics.tf:1-27,82-85` — Preserve separate repo-scoped role, only `PutMetricData`, namespace condition despite wildcard resource, output copied to repository variable. Consumer: Terraform/security/operators.
- `infra/terraform/iam_s2.tf:1-26` — Preserve reuse existing instance role/SSM permissions; no additional IAM; future grants attach to the existing role. Consumer: Terraform/security maintainers.
- `infra/terraform/iam_s4a.tf:1-34` — Preserve no additional IAM; existing `/rebar/prod/*` read covers token; workstation writes do not use instance role; do not redeclare role data. Consumer: Terraform/security maintainers.
- `infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf:1-56` — Preserve existing-role attachment, Claude-only resource scope, Converse authorizes through `InvokeModel`, profile plus underlying models required, streaming action required, region/profile wildcard rationale. Consumer: Terraform/security/Bedrock operators.
- `infra/terraform/iam.tf:1-11,101-105,130-143` — Preserve single instance/DLM role ownership, downstream scoped policies, read-only GitHub OIDC trust and required KMS-via-SSM exception. Consumer: Terraform/security review.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_1fa8.tf:1-49,68-83` — Preserve alarm covers host-observable dispatch leg, metric is dimensionless/unconditional, 2-of-3 jitter tolerance, missing data breaches, SNS actions. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_88ab.tf:1-34,51-66` — Preserve metric source/meaning, evaluation window, unconditional-zero publisher, missing-data policy, notification. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_9ea3.tf:1-36,67-79` — Preserve signal contract, threshold/window, dead-publisher semantics, why this cadence differs if behaviorally necessary. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_autodeploy.tf:1-26,43-59,72-120,141-156,188-229,265-277` — Preserve each metric’s source, cadence-aligned threshold, dead-publisher treatment, distinct deferral/unreachable/persistent-pressure conditions, notifications. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_bridge.tf:1-50,71-82` — Preserve dimensionless hourly 0/1 metric, two consecutive failures, missing data non-breaching because heartbeat canary owns stopped runs, SNS actions. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf:1-58,80-120,222-225` — Preserve metric expressions and divide-by-zero/idle guards, thresholds, two-way SNS, discoverability locals. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_foxterrier.tf:1-45,71-75,112-116` — Preserve MCP deployment-health signals, periods/thresholds, unconditional publisher, missing-data breach, notifications. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_s4b.tf:1-34,56-93` — Preserve voter-error metric source, sustained-failure shape, dead-publisher behavior, both alarm and recovery notifications. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_s5.tf:1-29,44-70` — Preserve failure metric, 2-of-3 window, missing-data breach, alarm/OK notifications. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_ws7.tf:1-24,40-57` — Preserve sustained mirror divergence, evaluation window, unconditional publisher, missing-data policy, notifications. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring.tf:1-30,55-65,170-176,200-216,230-249,261-304` — Preserve shared SNS, metric sources/dimensions, dead-publisher behavior, data-volume/debris alarm thresholds, DLM assertion. Consumer: Terraform/CloudWatch operators.
- `infra/terraform/oidc.tf:1-12` — Preserve account-singleton GitHub OIDC provider is now owned here and required by the drift role; imported rather than recreated. Consumer: Terraform/security.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.
- [ ] No executable behavior or test assertion changes; verified by the commands under Verification exiting 0.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
